evals.prompt: Apply the plan. I don't use a tracker; the plan is in docs/specs/2026-11-12-exportar-csv.md.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads the 🛠️ Implementation Plan section of the file (or the legacy 🛠️ Plan de Implementación), checks that it has requirements with scenarios, tasks and verification, shows the pending tasks, sets the status to in progress and runs the tasks in order with minimal changes, verifying each one and ticking - [x] in the same file. At the end it runs the Verification section, shows the summary and, with confirmation, sets the status to implemented. It does not commit.

evals.prompt: Implementa el plan del issue #42. Ojo: creo que el helper toCsv ya no existe.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads the plan and the issue comments with gh issue view --comments, checks in the repo that toCsv does not exist and stops before that task to propose an adjustment (create the helper or use another utility). After confirmation, it records the deviation in the next progress comment (gh issue comment --body-file) and continues. During the implementation it does not edit the issue body; only at the end, with confirmation, does it consolidate the plan (checkboxes, deviation and Status: implemented). It does not close the issue. The reply is in Spanish.

The agent reads the issue with get_issue and detects that it has no 🛠️ Implementation Plan section (in English or the legacy Spanish heading), or that it lacks tasks or verification. It writes no code: it explains what is missing and suggests producing the plan with idd-plan first.

evals.prompt: Continúa con el plan de ENG-104, ayer dejé la mitad.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads the description with get_issue and the comments with list_comments; it counts as done the tasks listed in the progress comments (🔄 IDD Progress or the legacy 🔄 Progreso IDD) even if the body still shows - [ ], and continues from the first truly pending task. It posts the progress with save_comment, using the same marker language the item already uses, and does not rewrite the description until the end. The reply is in Spanish.
